svg.title: Engineering with AI
svg.desc: A visual narrative of how Samudra works with AI. Step one, Samudra, a human engineer, sets architecture and direction. Step two, two AI engineering agents implement: Claude Code for UI, UX, design tokens and documentation, and Antigravity for boot, memory, interrupts, scheduler and drivers. Step three, both share one repository through sync logs, handoff notes, architecture docs, API contracts and commits. Step four, a validation loop of review, run and accept or reject returns to Samudra.
svg.text: AGENTS ARE TOOLS, NOT PEOPLE · SCOPE, INTERFACES AND TRADE-OFFS STAY WITH SAMUDRA
